html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The Super Villains and Anti-Heroes 
who have been at the center of various incidents have formed a team!

 

As we thank all Agents who have been with MARVEL Future Fight for the past 10 years,
we introduce the Marvel Studios’ <Thunderbolts*> inspired April Update.

 

Tier-4 has been added to Yelena Belova and Red Guardian, who now fight as a team,
and new Uniforms have been added to the updated heroes, including Sentry, 
a mysterious hero with multiple alter egos and unknown powers.

 

And U.S. Agent, who has risen for his honor, has joined MARVEL Future Fight with Tier-3 powers.

 

In addition, the new content, Team Battle Arena, 
where Agents can challenge each other with multiple teams, has been added.
Moreover, the rewards and features of Alliance Conquest have been improved,
and we have also prepared a 10-Year Anniversary Celebration Comic Card as a gift.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 

▣ One New Hero

Check out the abilities of U.S. Agent <Marvel Studios’ Thunderbolts*>
who has shed the role of Captain America and has stood to follow his own path.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 


▣ Three New Uniforms

 

Three new Uniforms have been added to celebrate the Marvel Studios’ <Thunderbolts*> inspired Update.
Check out the abilities of Yelena Belova <Marvel Studios’ Thunderbolts*>, 
Red Guardian <Marvel Studios’ Thunderbolts*>, and Sentry <Marvel Studios’ Thunderbolts*>.

 

* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 50% off during the <10-Year Anniversary Part. 1 - Discount Events!>, and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 


▣ Yelena Belova & Red Guardian Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Yelena Belova and Red Guardian.
These exceptional combatants will use every means to fight and accomplish their missions.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ U.S. Agent Tier-3

 

With the pride of an elite soldier, U.S. Agent 
has prepared his Tier-3 Ultimate Skill to accomplish his missions.

 

 

 


▣ Nova (Richard Rider) & Phyla-Vell Potential Awakening & Transcendence


Check out the Potential Awakening & Transcendence abilities 
of Nova (Richard Rider) & Phyla-Vell that will be added through the April update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Game Mode [Team Battle Arena]

 

Here is a new game mode where you can strategically form 5 teams and battle other Agents!
The Grandmaster has released a new game mode, [Team Battle Arena], and invites all Agents.

 

1. Agents who meet the following requirements can join the Team Battle Arena.
- Unlock Requirements: Clear Dimension Mission Difficulty 6

 

 


① Previous Rank: Check your previous rank.
② Arena Shop: Purchase gear and growth materials with Arena Tokens acquired from Team Battle Arena.
③ Set Team: Set your teams to participate in the Team Battle Arena.
④ Auto Repeat: Use Clear Tickets to auto repeat battles.

 

2. Each Team Battle Arena season will be held for 2 weeks.
- Each League starts with a score of ‘1000’ each season.
- The League will progress on a 14-day (2-week) basis, and reset on Fri 1:00 (UTC+0) / Thu 18:00 (PDT).
* Team Battle Arena will be closed for about 30 minutes after the season ends. 
Battle will not be available during this time.
- Team Battle Arena can be played right after the 4/28 Maintenance.
* The first season will be held for about 11 days. 

 

[League]
- Team Battle Arena consists of 6 Leagues, from Bronze to Challenger.
- The next season's league will be decided based on the score you have achieved in the current league.
* Everyone will start in the Bronze league in the first season. From the second season, Agents will be categorized into Bronze - Challenger leagues based on the score of the prior season. 
Bronze (81%-100%) / Silver (61%-80%) / Gold (41%-60%) / 

Platinum (21%-40%) / Vibranium (0%-20%) / Challenger (Top 50)
* Restricted Characters will be applied from the Gold League.

 

 

3. Set 5 teams consisting of up to three heroes. One team can be set as a hidden team.
- Other Agents cannot check the hidden team’s information.

 

 

 

4. Change the order of your teams after checking your opponent’s team before the battle.

 

- Consider the hidden team of your opponent when setting your team order!

 

The rules for winning and bonus point acquisition conditions are as follows.
 

▶ Rules for Winning
① First to win 3 battles out of 5
② Number of surviving heroes
③ Remaining HP of surviving heroes
④ The defending team wins in case of a draw

 

▶ Battle Points
- Acquire/lose battle points when winning/losing in battles.
- Additional win streak bonus points can be acquired when winning battles consecutively.

 

 

- Check the result of each round in the battle results screen.

 

 

- Stay tuned for the intense battles that await you, Agents.

 

5. Season Rank Reward: Acquire Arena Tokens, Gold, and Crystals 

as rewards based on the rank rewards of your league after the season ends.
- The rank will reset when the season ends.
- A trophy will be given to the 1st rank player. A new trophy will be given each season.

 

 

6. Arena Shop: Purchase various advanced gear and Tier-4 growth materials 
with Arena Tokens acquired from Team Battle Arena.

 

 


▣ [Alliance Conquest] Game Mode Improvement

 

The following improvements have been made 
to provide more rewards and a better experience for Agents who enjoy Alliance Conquest.
* The improvements will be applied from the season that begins on 5/2.

 

1. The list of rewards that can be acquired when Alliance Conquest is over has been improved.

 

 

 

2. The region protection time that activates when a region is occupied
will be reduced from 5 minutes to 3 minutes to speed up the Alliance Battle pace.

 

3. The Code Name of the Alliance member who is currently attacking a region will be shown.

 

4. The rewards list button has been added to the bottom of the Alliance Conquest world map screen 
so that Agents can check the required number of attacks during battle.

 


▣ 10-Year Anniversary Rewards


We have prepared gifts in gratitude for our Agents who have been with us
to celebrate the 10-Year Anniversary of MARVEL Future Fight.


1. Tap the banner that appears in-game after the update to acquire 
a Selector: Tier-4 Character, Uniform Ticket, and 10,000,000 Gold as a reward. 
- The reward can be acquired when accessing the game during the following period.
After the 4/28 Maintenance - 6/3 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0), 
After the 4/28 Maintenance - 6/3 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

 

 

2. A new Comic Card and a Comic Card Collection have been added 
in celebration of the 10-Year Anniversary of MARVEL Future Fight.
- The reward can be acquired from the 

“Thunderbolts* Update Celebration 7-Day Check-In Event” during the following period.
After the 4/28 Maintenance - 5/13 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0), 
After the 4/28 Maintenance - 5/13 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

 

* One option will be acquired based on set probabilities for the 3★~6★ bonus option.
* The Comic Card Collection effect is [Max HP ↑ +1%].

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for U.S. Agent, Yelena Belova, 
Red Guardian, Nova (Richard Rider) and Phyla-Vell will be added after the April Update.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ 10-Year Anniversary New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

A special Future Pass has been prepared for this pass to celebrate the 10-Year Anniversary.
① The amount of Gold and materials has been increased by 50%.
② An Advanced Potential Transcendence Ticket and a Tier-4 Advancement Ticket 
can be acquired when purchasing Legendary / Mythic passes.
 

③ A Selector: Tier-3 Character and a new Power Saving Mode Theme can be acquired from the normal pass.

 

[10-Year Anniversary Future Pass Plus Rewards]

- Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked 
will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased.
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end.
Please check the sale schedule in the game.
* 10-Year Anniversary Tokens can be acquired 

when purchasing 10-Year Anniversary Future Pass Plus Legendary / Mythic.
Legendary: 10-Year Anniversary Tokens x10
Mythic: 10-Year Anniversary Tokens x20

 

​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards and two more from the upcoming Event!

 

[April Update New Special Icon]

                

  

 

▣ 10-Year Anniversary Celebration Update Hot Deals

 

▶ Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule:
After the 4/28 Maintenance - 5/27 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 4/28 Maintenance - 5/27 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Various update celebration products, such as Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack 

and Custom Gear Unequip Pack are available under the “Update Hot Deals” category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

* ‘10-Year Anniversary Tokens’ will be added to the event products during the event.

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Story Fragment Integration: Story Fragments that were divided into each theme 

have now been integrated, and Story Fragment Chests will be changed.

 

[Story Fragment Integration]
- Story Fragments of theme 1 (Dimensional Clash) will now be changed to Integrated Fragments.
- After the April Update, only integrated [Story Fragment (Normal)] and [Story Fragment (Ultimate)] 

can be acquired from the Story game mode.

 

[2, 3, 4 Theme Story Fragments]
- 2, 3, 4 Theme Story Fragments that you possess can be changed to Integrated Fragments through Craft.
- One out of the 1-9 Integrated Fragments will be acquired randomly when Crafting, 
regardless of the number of the Story Fragment that has been used for Crafting.

 

[1-4 Theme Integrated Story Fragment Chest]
The four types of Story Fragment Chests from the prior Normal/Ultimate mode will be integrated into one.
- Level 1-6 Type Enhancement Tickets will be removed from the list.
- The acquisition chance of some items will be changed,
but the chances for C.T.P.s, Odin’s Blessing, and Premium Comic Cards will remain the same.

 

 

 

2. The Manual Camera Rotation mode has been added.
When the Manual Camera Rotation mode is set as “On” in Settings - Option (Lab category),
you can change the viewpoint of your camera by dragging the screen.
- Affected Game-Modes: Story. Dimension Mission, Dispatch Mission, Dimension Rift, 
World Boss, Zombie Survival, Multiverse Invasion, Giant Boss Raid, Preview Skill

 

- Change your viewpoint and view heroes and the background from various viewpoints!

 

3. Uniforms that could be purchased 

at a normal price of 1,250 Crystals or under can be purchased with Gold.

 

 

4. Changes regarding Seasonal Uniforms have been made.
① Seasonal Uniform Tickets with which Agents can purchase Seasonal Uniforms have been added.
- Seasonal Uniform Tickets will be on sale as a 10-Year Anniversary product. 
The acquisition method will be informed through a separate notice.
* Acquire one of the Seasonal Uniforms that have been released by using the Seasonal Uniform Ticket.
* Seasonal Uniform Tickets will be removed at a certain schedule after it is acquired.
We cannot assist with Uniform exchanges and item restorations after the Ticket has been removed.

 

② The “Season” mark will be displayed for Uniforms sold during a specific schedule in the Uniform menu.

 

 

5. The Accelerated Clear feature has been added to the Content Status Board.
- Agents can clear stages in the mission tab that can be auto-cleared without having to enter them.

 

 

6. Inventory: 50 slots will be added to the basic slots.

 

7. The Shadowland Auto Progress feature has been expanded from floor 15 to floor 25.

 

8. The minimum recommended specifications for MARVEL Future Fight have been updated.
- Before: iOS 12
- After: iOS 15

 

9. Returning Agent support benefits have been improved.
- New buffs for returning Agents who meet certain requirements have been added.
- The progress of Agents who are currently participating in the Returning Agent mission will be reset.
- Returning Agents can participate in the new mission with better rewards.
- Unclaimed progress rewards from previous returning Agent missions will be sent to the Inbox.

 

10. The Web Shop can now be accessed by tapping the icon at the main lobby screen.

 

11. Changes regarding Guided Quest: Trial Uniforms have been made.
- The discount information will not be displayed when discount Uniforms are not offered.

 

12. The difficulty of the Ranked Battle event game mode has been lowered.

- The target score has been lowered so that stage clear rewards can be obtained easily.
- Bonus points and buffs will now be applied at once when succeeding weakness attacks.
- Camera effects have been added to indicate the above when succeeding weakness attacks.
- The cooldown time and skill speed of certain boss skill patterns have been adjusted.
- The ignore dodge effect has been removed from the 1st and 3rd counter skill pattern of the boss, 
and can now dodge boss attacks with the ignore targeting effect of the hero.

 

13. The Timeline Quest Ticket recharge cooldown time has been decreased.
- Before: 90 minutes
- After: 60 minutes

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. <Classic> Uniform being equipped to Iron Man when tapping the Help button in 
Menu - Game Guide - Character Growth - Tier-4 Advancement has been fixed.


2. The increase rate of some buffs being displayed higher when tapping the Uniform Bonus tooltip 
of Ancient One <Unleahed Mystic> and <The Monk of Kamar-Taj> during battle has been fixed.


3. The pop-up screen not being displayed anymore when closing the Premium Growth Material Box
acquisition pop-up on the first day after purchasing the Daily Tier-4 Growth Support has been fixed.


4. The buff not being applied when Odin’s Might is overlapped
with some heroes moving fastly due to skill use in Alliance Battle: Legend has been fixed.


5. The unlock condition of some stages 

in Epic Quest: The Fate of Mankind being wrongly displayed has been fixed.


6. The victory pose of the Ghost <Modern> Uniform will now be displayed normally.


7. The skills Ghost <Modern>: Intel Gathering and Ghost <Marvel Studios’ Ant-Man and the Wasp>: 

Intel Gathering not being activated normally has been fixed,


8. Information that “Tier-4 Striker Skills will be excluded” has been added 

to the skill explanation of skills related to the “remove special effect area” effect.

 

 

We once again thank all Agents for enjoying MARVEL Future Fight for 10 years.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
